question: Should autoLinked become a permanent optional field in the exported MarkdownLinkSpan Plugin SDK contract for channel renderers?
rationale: The bug fix needs parser-origin information, but repository policy requires maintainer intent before establishing new public plugin API semantics.

options.title: Approve the optional provenance field
options.body: Keep autoLinked?: true as an additive shared contract, preserve it through every IR transformation, and require focused SDK and Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep provenance internal
options.body: Refactor the shared renderer to expose an internal predicate or rendering hook so external plugins do not receive parser-specific metadata.

options.title: Pause the shared API change
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers choose a stable provenance representation that can support other channel renderers without parallel APIs.

recommendation.title: Approve the optional provenance field
recommendation.body: Keep autoLinked?: true as an additive shared contract, preserve it through every IR transformation, and require focused SDK and Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice concerns permanent shared Plugin SDK surface rather than only Telegram presentation.
